# Opening cinematic art provenance

These five 1672 × 941 opening proof shots were generated using OpenAI's built-in image generation tool from existing project artwork as visual references, then converted to WebP at quality 90 without cropping or composition edits. They were created as narrative bridge shots for the opening, not as canonical puzzle diagrams. Source references were inspected visually; no claim is made that AI-only output necessarily creates copyright or grants rights held by others. See the repository content license for its scope.

- `kaelan-loupe-v1.webp`: generated October 28, 2026, using `15A_Kaelan.webp`, `13_ Crystal Array.webp`, and `generated/ceremony-opening-v1.webp` as identity, crystal, and setting references.
- `crystal-fracture-v1.webp`: generated October 28, 2026, using the crystal array and ceremony imagery; no puzzle diagram was intentionally rendered.
- `plaza-aftermath-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using ceremony and array imagery and the Kaelan bridge shot.
- `thalor-address-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using `15D_Lord Thalor.webp`, the ceremony, and crystal array as identity and setting references.
- `ceremony-shard-v1.webp`: generated October 29, 2026, using ceremony, array, and `generated/crystalshop-opening-v1.webp` as material and setting references; the shard is shown at the plaza, not an invented handling event.

Generated imagery is illustrative, not a precise representation of the game's branching-ring puzzle geometry. The canonical comparison should be drawn deterministically from game source. The images were visually reviewed; Thalor reads stern rather than smiling, and the shard extends slightly into the lower caption area.
